prompts:
Edit the supplied accepted v2 village image for Underwrite. Preserve its exact framing, low oblique orthographic camera, warm clean nonpixel 2D illustrated matte cell-shaded style, sunlight upper left and shadows lower right, scale and original perimeter castle walls and EVERY existing landmark in its original location: inn NW, manor north center, guild NE, forge west lower middle, market board east lower middle, secret arched underground entrance SW. Keep central well at its exact location and its flattened horizontal rim about 0.45 height/width. No people, creatures, letters, numerals or writing anywhere.
ONLY additions in the empty central paved space: fill the donut hole with compact attached mixed-species house blocks and a market street crossing the center. Need substantially increased density yet connected winding alleys and generous NPC standing clearances before every door and stall. Add THREE separate compact island blocks surrounded on all four sides by streets: upper middle-left of well, upper middle-right of well, lower middle below well. Each block several buildings directly attached, narrow roof depth, tall readable facade, human doors sized consistently with original doors (adult height135px at final3840x2160). Keep all original six door approaches open. Do not create a single giant palace or another huge empty plaza.
New architecture: humans most numerous, original ivory plaster timber red tile. At least THREE unmistakable elf homes integrated around LIVING TREE TRUNKS, curved swept green roofs, vine walls, raised wooden tree walkways. Place one in each island block so all three clearly visible. At least THREE squat THICK STONE smith/craft homes with broad chimneys, iron ingots, hammers, tongs outside, one per island block. At least FIVE distinct FAIRY housing sites, miniature knee-height doors next to human doors, tiny flower houses hanging beneath eaves and high on walls, flowerpots, clearly extremely small. Include paired human and tiny doors repeatedly.
Run rows of 8-12 open-front canvas market stalls across center in east-west broken rows around the well with walkable street between. Elf stall flowers/herbs, stoneworker stall iron bars/tools, fairy stall tiny low miniature goods. Cluster buckets, wash trough, handcart, sitting stones around well but retain standing pockets.
Distribute modest compact carts, planters, stacked goods at edges of remaining large empty expanses to break long straight empty rectangles; never scatter meaningless dots or tile-colored blockers. At least some real visible objects intersect most 240x135 cells in final3840x2160 map, target less than10% cells with no objects, while retain over30% truly traversable pavement and all six locations connected. Keep alleys winding, no huge long empty rectangle. Do not change original quiet pavement pattern or original buildings. Flat opaque image, same16:9 composition. Final desired3840x2160.
